extracted.intended_audience: NaNoWriMo participants / aspiring novelists looking for inspiration
extracted.subtask_description: An archive and description of 'Pep Talks' — short inspirational letters delivered to NaNoWriMo participants during November, written by well‑known authors to motivate novelists through the month-long challenge.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pep Talk purpose and format
rubrics_metrics.description: Pep Talks are inspirational letters written by well-known authors during NaNoWriMo. They’ll be delivered to your NaNoMail inbox throughout November.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are short, motivational messages intended to encourage participants during the November writing challenge; delivered episodically over the month via the site’s NaNoMail system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authorship / authority of pep talkers
rubrics_metrics.description: Pep talk veterans include well-known authors (examples: Aimee Bender, Dave Eggers, John Green, Neil Gaiman, Jonathan Lethem, Lois Lowry, Lemony Snicket) and the 2013 list includes a variety of published novelists and YA authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pep talks are curated from authors with established publishing credentials or public profiles; organizers select writers whose experience and reputations lend credibility and inspiration to participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience targeting (Young Writers Program note)
rubrics_metrics.description: Some of these links will take you to our Young Writers Program site, which has its own selection of YA pep talkers each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pep talks may be tailored to different participant groups (e.g., Young Writers Program vs. general NaNoWriMo audience); creators/curators should consider the target age group when composing messages.
